layman_headline: All three positions are green — let the winners ride toward their targets.
layman_explanation: The entire crypto market just had its best week in months, with Bitcoin blasting past $76,000 and dragging everything higher. Our three holdings — Ethereum, Hyperliquid, and Solana — are all sitting in profit (up 5.4%, 2.4%, and 3.7% respectively). The market mood has swung from cautious to greedy very quickly, which means we should enjoy the ride but stay disciplined with our existing exit targets rather than chase new positions at stretched prices.
layman_action: Hold all current positions and let them work toward profit targets. Don't add new positions right now — nearly everything has moved too fast in the last week. If ETH hits $2,520, SOL hits $100, or HYPE hits $83, take profits.
expert_reasoning: All swing candidates show extended 7-day moves (19-54%) making new entries poor risk/reward. BTC dominance at 59.3% remains elevated, warning against aggressive alt rotation. Fear & Greed jumped from 45.7 weekly average to 72 — a rapid shift that often precedes short-term pullbacks. Our three existing positions are well-structured with defined stops and targets; ETH is 45% of the way to its profit target, SOL is 25%, and HYPE is 15%. The prudent move is to let these trades mature rather than chase momentum at overbought levels. MON's RSI at 41 is interesting but below its SMA20, and the 30% weekly move suggests a dead-cat bounce rather than a fresh setup.
risk_factors: Fear & Greed surged from 46 to 72 in one week — rapid greed transitions often precede 5-10% corrections
BTC dominance at 59.3% means capital is concentrating in Bitcoin, creating headwinds for alt outperformance
Over $1B in shorts were liquidated — the squeeze fuel is depleted, and the next leg needs organic buyers
watch_list: ETH approaching $2,520 exit target — prepare to take profits if it reaches within 2%
BTC behavior around $76-78K resistance zone — a rejection here pulls everything down
Fear & Greed index — if it exceeds 80, tighten stops on all positions
market_context: Bitcoin broke above $76K and its 200-day moving average with massive ETF inflows ($800M single day), driving a broad market rally. The rapid shift from fear to greed suggests strong momentum but elevated short-term correction risk.
context_banner: All three portfolio positions are profitable in a surging market — discipline now means holding for targets, not chasing extended setups.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed jumped from weekly average of 45.7 to 72 (Greed), a rapid transition that historically signals caution for new entries but supports holding existing winners.
BTC topped $76K with $800M in combined BTC/ETH ETF inflows in a single day, providing the fundamental catalyst powering our existing positions higher.
Bitcoin broke above its 200-day moving average for the first time since November — a major technical milestone that validates the bullish trend supporting our holdings.
PUMP's RSI at 75 is overbought; MON at 41 is the only candidate near oversold, but it's below SMA20, making it a weak setup. No compelling new entry exists.
XRP surged 18.3% in 24h and 30.7% weekly with $8.4B volume on Ripple's RLUSD credit fund news, but the move is too extended for a fresh swing entry.
